audit_items.proof_trace: All queries in record_attendance_by_card use static PL/pgSQL SQL with variable binding (no EXECUTE, no || concatenation, no format('%s', ...) with p_card_id); PostgreSQL compiles static PL/pgSQL queries to parameterized SPI calls internally, making SQL injection impossible. The caller (actions.ts:60-62) also passes the value as a JSON parameter via Supabase RPC, not string-spliced SQL.
